# ufw_rule (Resource)

Manages a UFW firewall rule on a remote Linux system via SSH.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action to take: allow, deny, reject, or limit.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Human-readable comment for the rule.
- `port` (Number) Port number (1-65535).
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: tcp, udp, or any. Defaults to 'any'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Computed identifier for the rule (hash of rule attributes).
